# Eagle Appliance Repair

> Eagle Appliance Repair is the #1 rated and most trusted appliance repair company in West Jordan, UT, serving the surrounding areas. Voted best appliance repair service by local homeowners, we are licensed, insured, and known for top-rated workmanship, five-star customer reviews, and free estimates. Our team delivers award-winning appliance repair solutions that homeowners trust throughout West Jordan and beyond.
